svg.title: CH2 at 16 MS/s: every period folded - stray traces from dropped samples
svg.desc: CH2 at 16 MS/s: every period folded - stray traces from dropped samples. unit_interval: 9.89 us. frequency: 101 kHz. unit_interval_source: recovered from the signal. periods_folded: 6629. kind: data: phases carry both levels, so eye_width is the opening at the threshold. level_low: 868 mV. level_high: 2.88 V. threshold: 1.88 V. eye_height: 941 mV. eye_width: 9.89 us. eye_width_percent_of_ui: 100 %. jitter_tie_pp: 31.2 us. jitter_cycle_to_cycle_pp: 8.19 us. fitted_period: 9.88 us. unit interval recovered from 6632 rising crossings (median of 6631 intervals). the eye never closes: no sample falls between the two levels anywhere in the period, so eye_width is capped at one unit interval and says nothing about the edges — read the jitter numbers instead. time interval error (31.2 us) exceeds one unit interval: this signal probably stops and restarts rather than jittering — the fit assumes consecutive periods, so on a bursty line read the cycle-to-cycle number instead.
